name: Max Maggioni
headline: UKI Snr. Director of Solution Consulting
about:
I proudly lead the Oracle team of solution engineers and managers looking after all Oracle SaaS prospects and customers in the Private Sector in UK and Ireland.

I am fascinated by how Cloud computing, Mobile technology and Artificial Intelligence have changed the role of ERP, HCM and EPM solutions from mere day-by-day operational tools to easy-to-use, complete and real-time data-based products, that can meet the needs of any users, from the junior accountant to the CFO. 

Having a significant experience on end-to-end medium and large projects, I have developed a passion for helping organizations continuously improve their financial solutions performance through the adoption of the latest technology.
